weaknesses: The abstract inaccurately describes the contributions of the paper, suggesting a focus on conformal prediction which is not the primary topic.
Claims regarding the generalizability of the results are overstated; the performance improvements are shown only on specific tasks without broader validation.
The limitations of the proposed method are not adequately discussed, particularly regarding its applicability to simpler tasks where abstraction may not be beneficial.
strengths: The introduction of Step-Back Prompting is a novel approach that effectively leverages abstraction to improve reasoning in large language models.
Empirical results demonstrate significant performance improvements across a range of complex reasoning tasks, providing strong support for the proposed method.
The paper includes thorough error analysis, helping to identify specific areas where the proposed method succeeds and where it still faces challenges.
